name: North American major league (2026–27)
author: BallGM
description: Thirty teams, 82 games, a soft cap with a tax, two aprons and their restrictions, two over-cap allowances, a 14-team lottery: the 2023 collective bargaining agreement's structure at its 2026–27 figures. Figures in US dollars.

fidelity.detail: The top eight in each conference qualify directly, so seeds 7 and 8 never have to win their way in and 9 and 10 never get the chance.

fidelity.rule: Schedule weighting (4 v division, 3 or 4 v conference, 2 v other conference)
fidelity.detail: Opponent weightings are one figure per group, and a 30-team league cannot reach 82 that way (4/3/2 is 76, 4/4/2 is 86). The 82 games are spread as a balanced round robin instead.

fidelity.rule: Retention rights for a team's own free agents (full, early and non-retention)
fidelity.detail: A team can extend its own player before he reaches free agency, but cannot re-sign him over the cap once he is a free agent (scheduled for Milestone 9). Cap holds for departing players are not charged either.

fidelity.rule: Separate raise limits (8% re-signing own player, 5% elsewhere)
fidelity.detail: One raise limit applies to every contract; the preset uses the higher 8%.

fidelity.rule: Room exception, bi-annual exception, traded-player exceptions
fidelity.detail: The non-taxpayer allowance (15,044,000, withdrawn above the first apron) and the taxpayer allowance (6,064,000, withdrawn above the second) are modelled; the room exception (9,366,000), bi-annual (5,477,000) and trade exceptions are not.

fidelity.rule: Apron hard caps triggered by transactions
fidelity.detail: Using an allowance or acquiring a player in some ways hard-caps a team at an apron for the season. The preset withdraws the allowances above the aprons instead and sets no flat hard cap.

fidelity.rule: Second-apron sanctions on future picks, cash and sign-and-trade
fidelity.detail: Salary aggregation and taking back extra salary are blocked above the second apron; frozen first-round picks, the cash ban and the sign-and-trade ban are not modelled.

fidelity.rule: Draft lottery draws the top four picks only
fidelity.detail: The fourteen lottery teams' odds are the real weights (14% down to 0.5%), but every lottery slot is drawn by weight rather than only the top four.

fidelity.rule: Rookie scale, two-way and exhibit contracts
fidelity.detail: Draft picks sign at the minimum-salary scale; there are no two-way roster slots (Milestone 8 auxiliary slots).
No in-season tournament is played, and trades are allowed all season.
Head-to-head, division record, conference record, then point differential; records against playoff teams are not used.

fidelity.rule: Offer sheets and matching rights for restricted free agents

fidelity.detail: Most-valuable-player and the other voted awards need AI voters (Milestone 9); the preset hands out statistical titles instead.
